family.description: This entry represents the N-terminal domain of a family of proteins that includes RPA-related protein RADX from animals, the human member is also known as CXorf57. High-throughput sequencing used to identify genes driving tumorigenesis in Avian leukosis virus (ALV)-induced B-cell lymphomas, showed CXorf57 as the 10th most frequently targeted common integration site by ALV. ALV induces B-cell lymphoma and other neoplasms in chickens by integrating within or near cancer genes and perturbing their expression [[cite:PUB00138338]]. RADX is a replication factor A protein-like (RPA-like), single-stranded DNA binding protein recruited to replication forks to maintain genome stability [[cite:PUB00091321]]. It also modulates stalled fork protection by antagonising RAD51 [[cite:PUB00091322]]. These proteins consist of four tandem OB fold domains.
family.name: RPA-related protein RADX N-terminal domain
